payload.friendly_name: Print and PDF output: print layer, section and whole-site PDFs
payload.purpose_context: Readers in dark mode print a near-black page today, and a site cannot offer a section or the whole documentation set as one PDF. This mission delivers epic 377 (stories 378 to 382 and their tasks) as one change: a print layer for every page, a print control, a section and whole-site print route, a deterministic PDF CLI with a structure gate, an advisory CI lane, and deploy of the PDFs on main. Paged-media polish (383) and the pandoc/Typst spike (384) stay out of scope.
payload.purpose_tldr: Every page prints cleanly in either theme, and a site can publish deterministic section and whole-site PDFs built in CI.
